War Room E2E Test Fixture

This is a sample document used for integration testing.
It contains enough text to produce a meaningful token count
when processed by the files-service extraction pipeline.

Key points for deliberation:
1. Infrastructure resilience under load
2. Cost optimization for LLM-heavy workloads
3. Multi-agent coordination patterns
4. Cross-session knowledge transfer

This fixture validates the full upload → extract → tokenize → session-create pipeline.
